text:
Maria G: PTAL — I pushed updates to runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4234. Addressed the review comments and added a short changelog in the PR body. Summary: 1) fixed kv allocator rotation edge-case, 2) added unit + quick-smoke tests, 3) added a guarded fallback flag for allocator to avoid live regressions. Smoke command I ran locally:
```
make smoke TESTS=kv_allocator && ./scripts/smoke.sh --quick
```
Passed locally but saw one flaky e2e once (couldn't reproduce). Leaving this as a follow-up note in PR. PTAL when you have a minute.

Sanjay R: Thanks - will take a look this afternoon. Quick q: do we want a canary slot for this or is it safe to fast-track?

Maria G: Prefer a canary because allocator touches memory routing. I added a PR label "requires-canary" and set 'safe-to-fast-track' to false in the description. Also added a rollback note.

Alex T: I can do a quick pass now and focus on the tests. If we can get two approvals by EOD, ops can schedule tomorrow morning. @Jen P can you run a smoke e2e once Sanjay/Alex approve?

Jen P: Starting smoke run now, will post results in ~25m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ci-bot: CI: linux-unit ✅, integration queued, windows-unit ❌ (flake) — re-running tests.

Jen P: Smoke finished: unit + quick-smoke passed on my env, didn't reproduce the windows flake. Logged my run id in the PR. :thumbsup: 

Sanjay R: Quick review done — looks solid. Left one tiny comment about a comment string in allocator_test.go, nothing blocking. PTAL @Maria G

Maria G: Fixed that nit and force-pushed a small amend (s/allocater/allocator/). Thanks for catching it.

Alex T: LGTM, leaving approve. :rocket:

Sanjay R: Approved as well. :white_check_mark:

Maria G: Thanks everyone — I'll merge after CI stabilizes. Can ops hold rollout until 10:00 UTC tomorrow? Added a note to the PR and flagged deploy-ops.

Alex T: Noted — will coordinate canary window and monitor. Rollback policy in place if we hit issues.

Maria G: Great, closing the loop. Appreciate the quick reviews and the smoke runs.
